title: Planet Tweaks V3.0.3 NOVA TITAN - 1-Click Clip Compressor, Headphone Loudness Amplifier, Deep 808 Sub-Bass Studio & Themes Overhaul
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.0.3 NOVA TITAN: (1) 1-Click Clip Compressor: Transcode raw gameplay clips (.mp4, .mov, .mkv, .avi, .webm) into Discord-ready ~10MB videos using 720p scaling + CRF 28 + 96k AAC with 0ms background latency. (2) Headphone Loudness Amplifier & Sub-Bass Studio: Real-time Windows APO Loudness Equalization for +150% volume boost and +12dB 80Hz Deep Sub-Bass punch with 100% reversible rollbacks. (3) Themes Overhaul: 6 new viral Instagram themes (@niki.aroca) including Midnight Luxe, Sky High, Deploy Ready, Aqua Jade, Galactic Violet, and Charcoal Royal, with Mocha Brown preserved as default. (4) Debloat Tab Suite: Dedicated Microsoft Edge and Brave Browser debloating plus multi-select Start Menu AppX purge. (5) UI & Layout Polish: Sleek 1px dark obsidian card borders, solid graphite hover states, compact Drag Edit Studio sub-cards, and complete UTF-8 mojibake eradication.
